name: template_offboard
description: The sks_template example (modules/src/sks_template): OFFBOARD from the start, the module holds the entry course and altitude, turns the course by 30 deg after 5 s and climbs 10 m after 25 s; PX4's own altitude/speed, attitude and rate control below it.
